claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings and titrate support per spontaneous breathing and gas exchange.
Continue insulin infusion and monitor glucose closely given hyperglycemia (fingerstick 434 mg/dL, serum 383 mg/dL).
Monitor for anemia and consider transfusion if hemoglobin remains low (7.5 g/dL) with hemodynamic instability or ongoing blood loss.
Monitor coagulation parameters (INR 1.5, PT 16.6 s, PTT 29.9 s) and assess for bleeding risk.
Continue sedation with dexmedetomidine/fentanyl and titrate to target RASS, assessing for delirium (CAM-ICU positive).
Monitor blood pressure given hypotension episodes (systolic 87-92 mmHg) and adjust vasoactive or fluid therapy as needed.
Continue antimicrobial therapy (vancomycin, meropenem) and monitor for infection resolution; obtain cultures if not already done.
Monitor liver enzymes (AST 110, ALT 79, alkaline phosphatase 134) and bilirubin for hepatic dysfunction.
Monitor electrolytes (potassium 4.4-4.7 mEq/L, magnesium 1.9-2.0 mg/dL, phosphate 3.1-3.3 mg/dL) and replace as needed.
Perform daily assessment of sedation, delirium, and readiness for weaning from mechanical ventilation.
